notes.title: [PATCH 1.1.0] Content update - Earthrise
notes.notes:
Hi guys!

I'm really excited to present you the new update of Spacetours VR today. Thanks to the support of everybody I was able to develop a lot of new features. Many of them were created based on community feedback and criticism, thank you for your input! 

In V 1.1.0 Spacetours VR is closing the gap from a visually driven experience to an eductional explanation of our Solar System. Greatly increasing the depth of the experience, the new database and model viewer features introduce a new way of learning about the celestial bodies around us.
I really love the new content and hope you will like it too. Spacetours VR also became more beautiful, go check it out!

Cheers,
Christian

PATCHNOTES V1.1.0

New Features

     info panels for planets, moons and probes, accessible on your display column

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28007898/bc203f2afe7f69c4d1f6f7487f983581f0ccd4c7.jpg
 Each object in the game has now a description of its key features. Planets offer comparisons to Earth like scale and weight. The info panels for each planet are accessible by hovering over the glowing button  “touch to open” on the top of your display column with your motion controllers.
The tabs for moons and probes can also be opened and closed by hovering over the respecting buttons.


     3d model viewer planets structural layers

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28007898/6b0bde92d2eb0f7c5edcfb1a233eebb383b09589.jpg
 Planets on the info panels can be grabbed by holding the trigger of your controller when near them. When holding them you can access a scaled view with descriptions of the various structural layers by hovering over the button.


     3d model viewer moons geographical data

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28007898/d7466e704a31f6d3294eb03271fee9640b532455.jpg
 Moons on the info panels can also be grabbed like the other items. The detail mode offers a geographical survey and highlights key features on the surface.


     3d model viewer probes with technical components explained

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28007898/915757109faf3ca449138cb2d9dd0db41bc44421.jpg
 Grabbing probes from the info panels lets you access a detail mode with technical explanations of the various components they are made as well as the utility they provide. The detail view also has an explanation of the event that can be triggered by pointing your beam on the probe in orbit.
Some probes like MAVEN and Voyager have little extra event that can be triggered in this view.



     Earthrise - surface level moon surface

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28007898/8137ceec80790b2bbe8530ac9385a1c76834291d.jpg
 Originally the focus of this patch who would miss out on the first surface level positioned at the Apollo 15 landing site. Be aware the surface level is an experimental feature and will challenge the power of your system. Therefore it is a little harder to reach by attracting the moon in Earth's orbit with your beam and placing it on the console.



Updates

     Spacetours VR's shader models have been reworked to achieve a new level of image quality. Visuals are now much crisper at the same performance levels. The amount of detail in a large number of maps has also been increased.
     The display column now offers a visual feedback for the next step required to proceed.



Bugfixes

     fixed a bug where triggers for warp jump did not activate when placing the controllers at their position before their spawn. Warp jump will now always activate.
     fixed a bug where the markers and platforms from the ISS vista points did not despawn when changing levels.
     fixed a bug where it was impossible to return to Earth under certain circumstances.



 !!!!!!!! 
 Please be aware that the info panels are only available in English so far. A localization to German and Chinese will follow soon.

Bitte beachten Sie, dass die Info-Panels nur auf Englisch verfügbar sind. Eine Lokalisierung auf deutsch und chinesisch wird demnächst folgen.

 请注意，信息面板迄今只能使用英文。德语和汉语的本地化将尽快进行。
 !!!!!!!!

notes.title: [PATCH 1.0.2] Localization & Performance
notes.notes:
中文（简体）版已上市——包括语音内容 ! 

 Jetzt auch auf deutsch - inklusive Sprachausgabe! 


Greetings spacetourists!

Spacetours VR is now localized in German and Chinese also, including the voice overs. Performance is also increased, mainly during animations and for controller tracking.

I also updated the earth light map. You can now see lights from suburbs, much smaller cities and even heavily frequented roads!

I hope you all enjoy the new patch, feedback is greatly appreciated!

Cheers
Christian

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28007898/82a06f4be115613a70bd61a454a1229bd96efd09.jpg

notes.title: [PATCH 1.0.1] Performance Update
notes.notes:
Greetings spacetourists!

The first patch has gone live today, focusing on performance. Render parameters have been completely revamped and you should have a smooth experience on the full range of supported systems.

Patch notes can be found in the community hub forum.Feedback is greatly appreciated and I hope you enjoy your travels with Spacetours!

Cheers
Christian
